profile.headline: Founder/CEO/CTO at WithManyMinds |  Senior AI Dev/Strategy @RAND | Research, LLMs, Evals, AI Agents, Policy

positions.title: Senior AI Software Engineer/Technology Strategist
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
As a Senior AI Developer and Technology Strategist at RAND, I lead high-impact, cross-disciplinary projects that address some of the most pressing challenges in national security, healthcare, geopolitics, and beyond. My work focuses on leveraging advanced AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), to develop cutting-edge tools that transform decision-making and strategic planning.

###Biosecurity & Llama 405b Evaluation for the White House###
Assisted in the evaluation of Meta's Llama 405b model to assess biosecurity risks for the White House. This included fine-tuning the model, employing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and using the Inspect Platform to identify potential vulnerabilities. This project directly contributed to both global and national security by providing critical insights into the safe deployment of LLMs.

###National Security & Geopolitics###
Developed AI-driven frameworks to role-play and assess high-impact geopolitical scenarios. Created AI personas (e.g., National Security Advisor, Economic Policy Advisor) that interact with RAND's real-time research to simulate policy decision-making processes and provide strategic foresight.

###Healthcare Innovation###
Participated in a hackathon to develop AI-enhanced tools for healthcare proposal processes. Designed AI personas that streamline compliance matrices, timelines, and quality reviews.

###LLM Research & Development###
Built and deployed evaluation frameworks that test the problem-solving and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Projects included maze-solving evaluations for LLMs and virtual environments to assess AI behaviors in controlled, ethical scenarios.

###Game Development###
Applied AI to enhance digital and tabletop game development processes at RAND, including creating an AI co-pilot to assist with game design and rule generation for various strategic games.
positions.insights: Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM) and +3 skills

positions.title: Digital Transformation Strategist
positions.description:
• Enabling JPL's efforts to build first-of-a-kind spacecraft through effective data use and the application of graph technologies and artificial intelligence.
• Established as a leader in formulating strategies, innovating technology, governing IT, creating enterprise/information architecture, and facilitating communication.
• Effectively built consensus among technical Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), presented recommendations, and spearheaded multiple influential IT initiatives to advance the Lab's objectives.

positions.title: System and Data Engineering Group Supervisor
positions.description:
Managed a group of project managers and tasks leads who provide high availability middleware to the JPL Enterprise.

• Recruited specialized talent in a competitive field, effectively managing the entire process from candidate selection to onboarding.
• Oversaw contract management and budget management, ensuring cost-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
• Provided coaching and mentorship to team members, fostering their professional growth and enhancing their technical skills.
• Championed architectural design and project oversight for complex middleware platforms, effectively coordinating with cross-functional teams from various IT departments.
